junction.name: Southeast Freeway & 11th Street Southeast, Washington DC

claims.text: Southeast Freeway & 11th Street Southeast had 55 injury crashes in police records since 2021-10-31: 0 pedestrians injured, 0 cyclists injured and 1 person killed.
At the U.S. DOT's values that harm costs about $3.8 million a year.
No crash pattern here stands out against the city's worst crash locations.
The city's Leading Pedestrian Interval signals: not shown (at 267 sites the change in pedestrian injury crashes (-19%, 95% interval -35% to +1%) could be zero).
The District Department of Transportation (DDOT) is responsible for 11th Street Southeast (no route reference, so presumed a city street).
A request letter to the District Department of Transportation (DDOT) is ready to draft from these facts.
